chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as addressing both humans and jinn, highlighting the dual nature of creation's gratitude. The repetition underscores the infinite scope of divine favors, serving as a reminder of accountability on the Day of Judgment.
